tasks.name: קנייה אם יש מספיק כסף
tasks.note: Conditional subtraction: new balance after a purchase only if affordable, else unchanged.

tasks.name: משלוח חינם מעל 10
tasks.note: Threshold test on one input selecting between zero and the other input.

tasks.name: יום סוף שבוע?
tasks.note: Modulo-7 day-of-week then a range test: flag 15 when day counter d falls on days 5-6 of the week.

tasks.name: קנס איחור
tasks.note: Compare, subtract, multiply and saturate: days late times daily fee, capped at 15.

tasks.name: מיקום ההצעה הגבוהה
tasks.note: 0-based position of the largest element, with 15 as the not-found sentinel for an empty list.

tasks.name: יש שני מספרים עוקבים?
tasks.note: Pairwise search: flag 15 if any two values in the list differ by exactly 1, regardless of position.

tasks.name: האחרון מתחת ל-12
tasks.src: l=>{ for(let i=l.length-1;i>=0;i--){ if(l[i]<12) return l[i]; } return 0; }
tasks.note: Backward scan returning the last element below 12, or 0 if none.

tasks.name: ממוצע ציונים
tasks.note: Sum, count and integer division: the floor of the mean, 0 for an empty list.

tasks.name: שלושת האחרונים, החדש ראשון
tasks.note: Recent-items view: the last three elements, most recent first.

tasks.name: קניות לפי הסדר עד תקציב 30
tasks.src: l=>{ let s=0; const r=[]; for(const x of l){ if(s+x>30) break; s+=x; r.push(x); } return r; }
tasks.note: Loop with a running total: keep the longest prefix whose sum stays within a budget of 30.

tasks.name: טבלת מובילים: שלושה ראשונים
tasks.note: Leaderboard view: the three largest values, highest first (fewer if the list is short).

tasks.name: ירידות מחיר
tasks.note: Neighbor comparison: keep each element that is smaller than the one right before it.
